title: Global Recession Risk Tracker Update — Mon Jun 01, 2026

The Iran MOU entered its third day unsigned as Brent crude partially recovered to approximately $96.42 from $92.56, with the June 5 window — coinciding with the May Non-Farm Payrolls report — now the next critical convergence point for both oil markets and recession forecasters.
